$comment: Hand-maintained support table for Tailwind classes under @tamagui/tailwind. Sources: the Tailwind docs page (tamagui.dev/docs/core/tailwind), the claimed-utility grammar of @tamagui/style-grammar, and the native gating rules in @tamagui/tailwind's candidate resolver. test/support-oracle.test.ts checks it against the real resolver. Values are checked against src/data/config-tokens.json plus the theme and media names below, i.e. the config the theme pass generates.

assumedConfig.description: @tamagui/config/v6 defaultConfig, with light/dark themes extended by the shadcn theme variables and Tailwind's 2xl breakpoint added (what the theme pass generates).

block.reason: React Native has no block layout; `display: block` is dropped on native.

inline.reason: React Native has no inline layout; `display: inline` is dropped on native.

inline-block.reason: React Native has no inline layout.

inline-flex.reason: `display: inline-flex` is dropped on native, where elements are flex containers anyway.

grid.reason: CSS grid is not available on native; grid classes are dropped there.
grid.suggestion: Use flex rows/columns (or `web:grid native:flex`) for layouts that must match on native.

inline-grid.reason: CSS grid is not available on native.

table.reason: Table display has no native equivalent.

fixed.suggestion: Use `absolute` inside a full-screen container, or a Tamagui overlay/Portal.

invisible.suggestion: Use `opacity-0` (and `pointer-events-none`) to hide without removing layout.

truncate.reason: `truncate` sets text-overflow and white-space, which native drops.
truncate.suggestion: Use `line-clamp-1` for single-line truncation on native.

overflow-auto.reason: `overflow: auto` is dropped on native; views do not scroll.
overflow-auto.suggestion: Wrap scrollable content in a ScrollView.

aspect-auto.reason: `aspect-ratio: auto` is not a native value.

sr-only.reason: `sr-only` relies on clipping CSS that native drops, so the element becomes visible.
sr-only.suggestion: Render the text only on web (e.g. `web:sr-only native:hidden`) or move it into `aria-label`.

antialiased.reason: Font smoothing is a web-only CSS property.

subpixel-antialiased.reason: Font smoothing is a web-only CSS property.

list-none.reason: List markers do not exist on native.

list-disc.reason: List markers are not rendered on native (or by `html.li`).

list-decimal.reason: List markers are not rendered on native (or by `html.li`).

list-inside.reason: List markers do not exist on native.

list-outside.reason: List markers do not exist on native.

transition.suggestion: Use Tamagui's `transition` prop with an animation driver for native.

transition-all.suggestion: Use Tamagui's `transition` prop with an animation driver for native.

transition-colors.suggestion: Use Tamagui's `transition` prop with an animation driver for native.

transition-opacity.suggestion: Use Tamagui's `transition` prop with an animation driver for native.

transition-shadow.suggestion: Use Tamagui's `transition` prop with an animation driver for native.

transition-transform.suggestion: Use Tamagui's `transition` prop with an animation driver for native.

peer.reason: `peer` markers drive sibling selectors, which native does not have.

z-auto.reason: `z-index: auto` is not resolved on native.

max-w-none.reason: `max-width: none` is not resolved on native.

max-h-none.reason: `max-height: none` is not resolved on native.

prefixes.reason: Shadow colors (`shadow-<color>`) are not applied on native.
prefixes.suggestion: Use an arbitrary shadow such as `shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]`.

webOnlyKinds.reason: Unbracketed ratios (`aspect-4/3`) are not resolved on native.

prefixes.reason: Cursors other than `auto`/`pointer` are dropped on native.

prefixes.suggestion: Use the Image `resizeMode`/`objectFit` prop on native.

before.reason: `::before` pseudo-elements do not exist on native, so this content is lost there.
before.suggestion: Render the decoration as a real child element (e.g. an absolutely positioned `View`).

after.reason: `::after` pseudo-elements do not exist on native, so this content is lost there.
after.suggestion: Render the decoration as a real child element (e.g. an absolutely positioned `View`).

placeholder.reason: The `placeholder:` variant styles `::placeholder`, which native does not have.
placeholder.suggestion: Use the `placeholder-<color>` utility, which maps to `placeholderTextColor` on native.

file.reason: `file:` styles the file selector button, which native does not have.

selection.reason: `selection:` styles `::selection`, which native does not have.

marker.reason: List markers do not exist on native.

first-letter.reason: Pseudo-elements do not exist on native.

first-line.reason: Pseudo-elements do not exist on native.

checked.reason: `:checked` is web-only; Tamagui Checkbox/Switch expose checked state through props.

enabled.reason: `:enabled` is web-only; use `disabled:` for the inverse.

portrait.reason: Orientation media queries are not configured; add them to your Tamagui media config to use them on native.

landscape.reason: Orientation media queries are not configured; add them to your Tamagui media config to use them on native.

rtl.reason: `rtl:` uses a `[dir]` selector, which is web-only.

ltr.reason: `ltr:` uses a `[dir]` selector, which is web-only.

prefixes.reason: `group-*` variants other than interaction states (hover, press, focus, focus-visible, focus-within, disabled) use selectors that native does not have.
`peer-*` variants use sibling selectors, which native does not have.
`data-*` attribute selectors are web-only, so this style does not apply on native.
prefixes.suggestion: Drive the style from a prop or state instead (e.g. a styled() variant).

prefixes.reason: `aria-*` attribute selectors are web-only, so this style does not apply on native.
prefixes.suggestion: Drive the style from a prop or state instead (e.g. a styled() variant).

prefixes.reason: Arbitrary min-width breakpoints are web-only; use a configured media query.
Only configured `max-*` media queries (max-sm, max-md, ...) work on native.
Only container queries named after configured media queries work on native.

arbitrary.reason: Arbitrary selector variants are web-only, so this style does not apply on native.

variants.containerWarning: Tamagui resolves `@<size>:` container queries against the media query of that name (e.g. `@md` is 768px), while Tailwind's container sizes are smaller (`@md` is 28rem); check the breakpoint.

arbitraryValues.reason: CSS variables and functions other than `calc()`/`clamp()` do not resolve on native.
arbitraryValues.suggestion: Use a token or a plain value (px, %, rem) that native can resolve.

important.reason: `!important` classes are not resolved by Tamagui; they pass through to CSS on web and are dropped on native.
important.suggestion: Remove the `!` and rely on class order (the last class wins in Tamagui).

webPassthrough.$comment: Classes Tamagui does not claim on web are compiled by @tamagui/tailwind/vite with Tailwind's default theme and default variants, not the app's CSS. test/web-passthrough.test.ts checks the prediction against @tamagui/style-grammar's classifier.

customVariants.$comment: shadcn/tailwind.css custom variants, as the Radix-style attributes Tamagui UI primitives set.

nativeAssumedVariants.$comment: Variants assumed true on native, where data-* variants are dropped: Radix and Tamagui components default to horizontal. A supported class behind one of these (also as group-*) gets a native: twin.
